description: Master the middle 24 s of the track in 2-6 presets at once and get each one's loudness plus a listen link. FREE (6 per day). Use this instead of guessing a preset, and instead of burning a token to 'try' one.

audio_url.description: Public https URL of the audio file (wav/mp3/flac/m4a). A share link to the page works too — Suno/Udio song pages, Google Drive and Dropbox links are resolved to the file automatically.

styles.description: Preset keys from list_presets. Default: edm, pop, rnb, standard.
